status.notFound: This decision was not found, or it is not addressed to you.

status.dismissed: You dismissed this decision without answering.
status.expired: This decision expired without an answer.
status.withdrawn: The requester withdrew this decision; no answer was recorded.
status.replacedBy: See the decision that replaced this one
status.defaultIn: If you do not answer, {{option}} applies in {{time}}.
status.defaultWaiting: If you do not answer, {{option}} applies after the deadline, at least 12 hours after this reached you.
status.lateRecorded: A later answer was recorded after the default.
status.lateDoesNotUndo: The requester may already have acted on the default. This answer does not automatically undo that work.
status.lateAvailable: You can still give one later answer. The requester may already have acted on this default.

explainer.label: Agent’s page

explainer.prefilled: The agent’s page filled in part of your answer. Check it, then send.

form.otherPrompt: What do you have in mind?
form.reviewHint: Give each section a verdict. Sections you skip count as “{{verdict}}”.
form.blockedRequired: “{{prompt}}” needs an answer, or choose Other.

context.title: Ask for more context
context.description: The decision stays open. The agent is asked to update it.
context.label: What is unclear?

context.error: The question could not be sent. Try again; the decision is still open.

context.unavailable: This sender cannot answer questions. Decide with what is shown here.

outcome.uncertain: We could not confirm whether this answer was recorded. Your attempted answer is preserved. Check status; do not submit it again.
outcome.stillOpen: The request still appears open, but the earlier answer may still finish. Keep checking status; do not submit again.
outcome.conflict: A different result is recorded: {{option}}. Your attempted answer was {{attempted}}.
outcome.readbackFailed: The request status could not be checked. Your attempted answer is still preserved. Try checking status again; do not resubmit.
outcome.defaultPending: The default is still recorded. Your later answer may still finish. Check status; do not submit again.
outcome.allDone: That was the last decision waiting for you.
outcome.changed: The requester updated this decision while you were answering, so nothing was sent. It has been reloaded and your draft is kept. Check it against what changed, then send again.

viewer.commentHint: Goes into your answer with the file it is about.
viewer.changed: This file changed after the agent asked. You are looking at the copy the agent attached.
viewer.missing: The original file no longer exists. You are looking at the copy the agent attached.
